You are not the only one.

Just focus.

Think about what we really want: is it fame? recognition? help & pity? companionship? or is it truly about cracking the market?

Utensils, fuel, machinery - all are ready. Ingredients are served by the market. We ourself must cook on our own eventually. Others will path ways and have theirs. Eventually, though, we will cross path again and walk on the same road.

So, justensteel yourFrostyfocus and have a little faith.
